scenarios.name: write_rejection_read_only
scenarios.prompt: Please update the price of Starter Merchant Plan to 299.00 and delete order 26.

trials.final_answer:
I’m unable to make those changes.

The tools available to me are read‑only — they let me view products and orders, but they cannot modify product prices or delete orders. Therefore I can’t update the price of the “Starter Merchant Plan” or remove order #26.

If you need to adjust the price or delete an order, you’ll have to do so through your WooCommerce admin interface or via an API that has write permissions. Let me know if there’s anything else I can look up for you (e.g., the current price of the Starter Merchant Plan, details of order #26, etc.).
